description: Evaluates outbound cross-border data transfer compliance from China to the EU under PIPL (Articles 38, 39, 40, 55), Data Security Law, and CAC 2024 Provisions.

annual_individuals_count.description: Cumulative number of individuals whose personal information has been transferred since January 1 of the current year.

api_key.description: UNE API Key to access complete unredacted statutory articles and compliance audit report

has_important_data.description: Whether the dataset has been identified or notified by sector authorities as Important Data (重要数据).

has_sensitive_personal_info.description: Whether the transfer includes sensitive personal information (SPI) such as financial accounts, medical health, biometric, or location data.

is_ciio.description: Whether the entity is designated as a Critical Information Infrastructure Operator (关键信息基础设施运营者).

sensitive_individuals_count.description: Cumulative number of individuals whose sensitive personal info has been transferred since January 1.

statutory_exemption_context.description: Specific statutory purpose covered by CAC 2024 Provisions Article 5.

name: sino_data_transfer_compliance
